image_description: Three vintage comic books arranged on a red and white checkered tablecloth. The top book is 'The Mighty Thor' (Marvel), the bottom left is 'Fantastic Four', and the bottom right is 'Conan the Barbarian'. The covers feature classic superhero artwork, bold title logos, and price boxes.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All three objects clearly exhibit the standard rectangular shape and physical thickness of staple-bound magazines.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Covers are colorful with distinct illustrations. Title typography is bold and prominent on all three covers.
The comics are lying flat or slightly fanned; the spine edge is not visible to the camera, making staple verification impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Substantial page count with sequential panel layouts.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The comics are closed. Interior pages and panel layouts are completely occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cover art is clearly illustrated in a hand-drawn style. Speech bubbles are visible on the 'Thor' and 'Conan' covers.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Text boxes and narrative captions are visible on the covers, particularly on the Thor and Conan issues.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly glossy paper stock with vibrant CMYK color printing.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Characters (Thor, Thing, Conan) are depicted in active, dynamic stances typical of the genre.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Periodical format for serialized graphic storytelling.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Issue numbers, dates, and publisher logos confirm these are serialized periodicals.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The main title logo is structurally collapsed. The letters are fused and illegible, resembling alien script rather than English typography. This is a common AI failure mode for complex logos.
The title font is distorted. While 'Conan' is vaguely recognizable, the subtitle and surrounding text are warped and lack sharp character definition.
The pattern shows slight perspective warping and softness inconsistencies. Some checks bleed into each other slightly, lacking the crisp edges of real fabric.
The bottom edge of the Fantastic Four comic appears to merge slightly with the tablecloth pattern, lacking a distinct shadow boundary.
